description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of missing pieces and the number of possible solutions for M-Cube, comparing two scenarios: "CUBE" and "Flip ignored". The x-axis represents the "# Missing pieces" on a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 6 with integer tick labels at every unit interval. The y-axis represents the "# Possible solutions" on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 10^2 to 10^8 with tick labels at every two orders of magnitude. The "CUBE" line is depicted in orange with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 10^2.5 possible solutions when there is 1 missing piece and increasing to around 10^8 when there are 6 missing pieces. The "Flip ignored" line is shown in blue with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at roughly 10^1.5 possible solutions for 1 missing piece and rising to about 10^6.5 for 6 missing pieces. Both lines exhibit a consistent upward trend as the number of missing pieces increases.
